## Description and Rationale

We are a small team interested in data, AI, and building practical things with technology. We enjoy exploring problems, experimenting with different approaches, and learning by actually working on challenging problems.

We decided to join the PRC Data Challenge 2026 mainly because it looked like a fun opportunity to test our skills on a real-world data problem. We are not joining with a specific expectation of winning. We want to see how far we can get, learn from the challenge, and compare our approach with other teams.

For us, the challenge is also a chance to step outside our usual projects and work on something different. We are looking forward to exploring the dataset, finding interesting patterns, and hopefully coming up with a solution that is both creative and effective.
